title: Vector-parameter margins dichotomy beyond the scalar DS15 class
statement: Complete the academic margins dichotomy beyond the audited d_psi=d_lambda=1 DS15 class. For d_psi>1, establish the required uniqueness and rigidity theory for vector-D quantization of the efficient score before transferring the degenerate-attainer argument. For d_lambda>=2 and K>=d_psi+d_lambda+1, construct or refute a vector-(R) steering mechanism spanning all nuisance directions. The rank-vacuous boundary K=d_psi+d_lambda is already excluded by CE-DS-MARGINS-RANK-VACUITY-001. The deployment-facing non-centered DS18 remainder is closed by DS19's value-consistent interval-DP primal and is not part of this P6 question.
warning: Academic P6 remainder only. Do not reopen DS18 or DS19, and do not infer the vector-POI dichotomy from scalar uniqueness or the vector-nuisance steering result from the one-dimensional sign construction. Preserve K>=d_psi+d_lambda+1.
